text:
zoe: quick sync prototype idea: compact token meter as a micro-badge on the outgoing bubble + icon-only stop next to send. keep composer height steady. reactions?

indra: sounds nice for density. concern: tiny badges + icon-only controls are easy to miss for keyboard/AT users. we need offscreen labels and focus targets.

frank: propose 2 quick variants to test: A) "~42" tilde numeric in-bubble, B) ring progress with hover tooltip. A is clearer; B is cleaner visually.

zoe: agree on A/B. also want the streaming value to show as approximate (tilde) and flip to exact when complete. microcopy: "approximate while streaming" under the badge.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: aria-live polite for updates (throttle ~400ms), offscreen text like "Tokens updating: approx 42", visible focus ring for icon-only stop, contrast >= 3:1 for small badge text.

mike: keyboard nits: Esc conflicts with browser/back. recommend Esc = stop-only, Shift+Enter = regenerate. also add a small tabbable stop button with aria-label "Stop generation".

indra: prompt library conflict: current drawer overlays badge on narrow widths. move prompt toggle into composer overflow on small screens so drawer pushes canvas.

frank: perf: debounce estimator updates (300-400ms) separate from render frames. sample pseudo to debounce display.

zoe: next steps: A/B prototype, aria-live at 400ms, move prompt toggle to composer overflow on narrow widths, change keyboard mapping (Esc stop-only, Shift+Enter regen), tabbable stop with screen-reader text, microcopy tweak. i'll open tickets and tag design/research. :thumbsup:
